title: 第522章 小丹仙 我悟了第521章 姐妹入宫丹仙求见
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 拜三祖为师？
江渊听着小丹仙的请求，脸上没什么表情。
这事，倒是在他的意料之中。
当初在流光大世界外，三祖江道衍与小丹仙那场隔空论道，虽然只是寥寥数语，却足以让任何一个丹道修士，都为之疯狂。
那是境界上的绝对碾压。
小丹仙能有此想法，再正常不过。
江渊放下茶杯，看着眼前这个神情紧张，却又带着无比坚定之色的少女，淡淡地说道：“就为了这事？”
小丹仙一愣，下意识地点了点头：“是……是的。”
对她而言，这已经是天大的事了。
三祖是何等人物？江家老祖，大帝级的炼丹师！
想拜他为师，别说是她一个外人，就算是江家本族的那些丹道天才，都未必有这个资格。
她本以为，自己说出这个请求后，江渊会提出一些苛刻的条件，或者至少会仔细盘问一番。
却没想到，对方的反应，竟是如此的平淡。
仿佛她说要去拜的，不是一尊大帝，而是一个寻常的教书先生。
“小事一桩。”
江渊随口说道，他看着小丹仙那副紧张的样子，心中忽然起了几分玩味。
他手腕一翻，一枚通体赤金、表面流转着细密道纹、散发着浓郁造化气息的丹药，出现在了他的掌心。
“所有入宫的女修，都会得到一枚升灵丹，这枚丹药也算是见面礼了。”
江渊屈指一弹，那枚丹药便化作一道流光，稳稳地落在了小丹仙的面前。
小丹仙下意识地伸手接住，当她的指尖触碰到丹药的瞬间，整个人如遭雷击，彻底呆立当场。
她那双清澈的眸子瞪得滚圆，死死地盯着掌心那枚丹药，连呼吸都停滞了。
“这……这道韵……这气息……”
她身为准帝级的炼丹师，对丹药的感知何其敏锐。
只是一瞬间，她就判断出，这枚丹药的品阶，远远超出了她的认知！
她自己耗费百年心血，以万年灵脉精华为引，辅以三十六味混沌灵药才炼制出的【造化天灵丹】，在这枚丹药面前，简直就像是路边的野草，与天上的仙葩一般，毫无可比性！
那丹药之上流转的道纹，浑然天成，仿佛是天地大道亲自烙印上去的。
那股精纯到极致的造化气息，只是闻上一口，就让她感觉自己那停滞了许久的丹道瓶颈，都隐隐有了一丝松动！
最可怕的是，她能清晰地感觉到，这枚丹药之中，没有一丝一毫的杂质！
这意味着什么？
这意味着，这枚丹药的成丹率，以及服用后的效果，都达到了一个理论上的完美状态！
“这……这不可能……”
小丹仙喃喃自语，她的声音都在发抖，
“世间……世间怎么可能会有如此完美的丹药？”
她猛地抬起头，看向江渊的眼神，已经从最初的敬畏，变成了狂热。
content_en:
Worship the Third Patriarch as your teacher?
Jiang Yuan listened to Xiao Danxian's request with no expression on his face.
This was something he expected.
Outside the Great World of Flowing Light, the distant discussion between Third Patriarch Jiang Daoyan and Little Alchemy, although only a few words, was enough to drive any Alchemy monk crazy.
That was an absolute crushing in terms of realm.
It is perfectly normal for Xiao Danxian to have such an idea.
Jiang Yuan put down the tea cup, looked at the nervous but determined girl in front of him, and said calmly: "Is this the reason?"
Xiao Danxian was stunned and nodded subconsciously: "Yes... yes."
To her, this was a big deal.
What kind of person is the Third Patriarch? Ancestor of the Jiang family, an emperor-level alchemist!
If she wanted to become his teacher, let alone her as an outsider, even the alchemy geniuses from the Jiang family might not have this qualification.
She originally thought that after she made this request, Jiang Yuan would put forward some harsh conditions, or at least cross-examine her carefully.
But he didn't expect that the other party's reaction would be so dull.
It seemed that the person she wanted to worship was not a great emperor, but an ordinary teacher.
"It's a piece of cake."
Jiang Yuan said casually. He looked at Xiao Danxian's nervous look and suddenly felt a little playful in his heart.
He flipped his wrist, and an elixir that was entirely red gold, with fine lines flowing on its surface, and exuding a strong aura of creation, appeared in his palm.
"All female cultivators who enter the palace will receive a spiritual elixir. This elixir can be regarded as a meeting gift."
Jiang Yuan flicked his finger, and the elixir turned into a stream of light and landed steadily in front of the little elixir.
The little elixir subconsciously stretched out her hand to catch it. The moment her fingertips touched the elixir, her whole body felt as if she had been struck by lightning, and she was completely stunned on the spot.
Her clear eyes were widened, staring at the pill in her palm, and even her breathing stopped.
"This... this rhyme... this breath..."
As a quasi-emperor level alchemist, she has an extremely keen sense of elixirs.
In just a moment, she judged that the quality of this elixir was far beyond her knowledge!
She spent a hundred years of hard work, using the essence of ten thousand years of spiritual veins as a guide, and supplemented by thirty-six chaotic elixirs to refine the [Celestial Spirit Pill of Creation]. In front of this elixir, it is just like weeds on the roadside, and it is incomparable with the fairy flowers in the sky!
The Dao patterns flowing on the elixir were completely natural, as if the Dao of Heaven and Earth had been imprinted on it personally.
Just one whiff of that extremely pure breath of creation made her feel that her long-stagnant alchemy bottleneck was faintly loosened!
The most terrifying thing is that she can clearly feel that there is not a trace of impurities in this pill!
what does that mean?
This means that the elixir's elixir formation rate and the effect after taking it have reached a theoretically perfect state!
"This...this is impossible..."
Xiao Danxian murmured to herself, her voice trembling,
"How...how could there be such a perfect elixir in this world?"
She raised her head suddenly and looked at Jiang Yuan with eyes that had changed from awe at first to fanaticism.
title_en: Chapter 522: Little Alchemy, I have realized it Chapter 521: Sisters enter the palace to ask for an audience with the Alchemy
